researchStatus: Period-plausible construction specification for generated fallback; exact housing-complex manufacturer/model verification remains pending field/photo reference.
visualTarget: 4K live-action-film plausibility; no baked lighting in albedo; angular response must come from PBR lighting.

materials.label: Aged painted reinforced-concrete exterior
materials.materialFamily: reinforced concrete + cementitious leveling/render + exterior acrylic/silicate-style coating
materials.finish: matte mineral-looking topcoat, locally chalked by UV and rain
materials.frontLightResponse: Broad diffuse return with weak wide dielectric highlight; aggregate must not sparkle like stone polish.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Slight Fresnel lift and readable micro-roughness across shallow relief; no mirror stripe.
materials.shadeResponse: Retain color separation from ambient sky/ground fill; do not crush to gray-black.
forbidden: razor-flat facade with no construction joints

materials.label: Aged anodized aluminum sash and rail extrusion
materials.materialFamily: extruded aluminum with aged anodized oxide finish
materials.finish: low-satin silver-gray anodized surface with fine extrusion direction
materials.frontLightResponse: Muted metallic/surface reflection with a narrower lobe than painted concrete; extrusion direction should subtly shape highlight.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Strongest readable edge reflection at shallow view angle without becoming chrome; oxide/age broadens the lobe.
materials.shadeResponse: Reflect sky color softly; must not become self-lit silver.

materials.label: Dark aged galvanized steel hardware
materials.finish: weathered low-satin galvanized surface, darkened by age and recess grime
materials.frontLightResponse: Compact subdued metallic highlight; galvanized microstructure remains subtle at gameplay distance.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Noticeable metallic edge reflection, broadened by oxidation and grime.
materials.shadeResponse: Dark but still separates from rubber via metallic sky reflection.
agingCauses: localized rust only after coating breach/ferrous source

materials.label: Aged EPDM sash seal and track insert
materials.frontLightResponse: Very broad weak dielectric highlight; reads as rubber, not black paint.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Slight Fresnel edge lift only; remains broad and dark.
materials.shadeResponse: Must retain charcoal separation and contact shadow without clipping to pure black.

materials.label: Sun-aged outdoor AC ABS casing
materials.finish: warm off-white satin plastic with mild oxidation/chalking
materials.frontLightResponse: Soft broad plastic highlight; panel curvature and molded edges define the response.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Fresnel lift on casing edges remains dielectric and broader than metal.
materials.shadeResponse: Warm aged plastic stays distinguishable from cool aluminum and wall paint.

materials.label: Aged refrigerant-line insulation/tape cover
materials.materialFamily: foam insulation with weathered vinyl/PVC wrap
materials.finish: warm gray-beige matte wrap with slight seam relief
materials.frontLightResponse: Mostly diffuse with faint broad polymer highlight; wrapping seam should catch subtle side light.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Thin edge/seam lift only, no metallic streak.
materials.shadeResponse: Retains warm material identity against concrete.
agingCauses: rain cleaning on exposed vertical runs

materials.label: Dark flexible condensate drain hose
materials.finish: dark gray matte polymer with shallow circumferential texture
materials.frontLightResponse: Soft polymer response; shallow ribbing may break the broad highlight.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Dielectric edge reflection strengthens when wet but does not become mirror-like.
materials.shadeResponse: Must remain readable against deep balcony shade through shape/contact shadow.

assemblies.label: Apartment exterior wall bay
assemblies.nominalDimensions: structural bay approx 4.15 m wide x 2.55 m floor pitch; exact wall thickness not yet derived from source drawings
assemblies.manufacture: reinforced-concrete structural wall/slab with exterior leveling/render and protective topcoat
assemblies.mounting: monolithic/panel RC structure; finish bonded to substrate; openings formed before sash installation
assemblies.interfaces: window opening returns, balcony slab edge, pipe penetrations, stair enclosure joints and grade transition require physical gaps/drips/seals
assemblies.orientationExposure: camera-facing exterior receives midsummer sun/rain; lower 0.4 m is splash-prone; recesses stay damper/dirtier
assemblies.aging: UV chalking, ledge-driven rain streaks, ground splash, recess grime; no arbitrary facade-wide noise
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: openings, slab lips, construction gaps, sill/drip edges and penetrations are geometry; aggregate/chalking microdetail is material response

components.attachment: mechanically fixed/embedded at opening base with sealed wall interface

assemblies.lookdevBrief: Show one facade bay as front elevation, 35-degree oblique and 100% crop. Separate wall coating, opening return, sill projection, seal line and contact shadows. Include dry frontal sun and grazing sun versions; no baked highlight.

assemblies.label: Two-panel aluminum sliding window
assemblies.nominalDimensions: 2.36 m x 1.76 m outer frame; 65 mm visible frame members; 32 mm track inserts in generated fallback
assemblies.manufacture: extruded anodized aluminum outer frame and sash members with rubber weather seals/track inserts and discrete handles
assemblies.mounting: frame mechanically fixed into concrete opening; perimeter seal separates metal from wall; overlapping sash stiles ride in upper/lower tracks
assemblies.interfaces: frame-to-wall seal, sill drip edge, overlapping center stiles, track recesses and handle contact zones
assemblies.orientationExposure: rain-exposed outer frame with recessed tracks; sill upward face receives water/dust; handles receive human contact
assemblies.aging: water spotting and runoff below sill, recess grime in tracks, slight aluminum dulling, cleaner handle contact
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: frame/stiles/tracks/handles/sill are geometry; extrusion grain, oxidation, rubber grain and water spotting are material response

components.attachment: fallback dark hardware; dedicated handle material still desired

assemblies.lookdevBrief: Exploded oblique window study showing frame, two offset center stiles, upper/lower track, rubber insert, handle and sill. Compare frontal sky fill with grazing midsummer sun so aluminum Fresnel and rubber roughness are visibly distinct.

assemblies.label: Balcony rail and anchorage
assemblies.nominalDimensions: seven post positions at 0.48 m spacing; 130 x 140 x 25 mm fallback base plates; paired 18 mm-scale bolt heads
assemblies.manufacture: anodized aluminum rail members with galvanized steel base plates/brackets and ferrous fasteners
assemblies.mounting: posts mechanically anchored through individual base plates to balcony slab; divider brackets fixed at low/high points
assemblies.interfaces: plate-to-slab contact, bolt/washer seats, rail joints, balcony lip and divider attachment
assemblies.orientationExposure: fully rain/sun exposed; horizontal rails collect dust; hand-height rail has contact wear; base plates concentrate runoff
assemblies.aging: aluminum dulling, galvanized oxidation, localized rust bleed only from ferrous/coating breach sources, cleaner hand-contact zones
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: posts/rails/plates/bolts/brackets/gaps are geometry; oxide, fine scratches and runoff discoloration are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Low oblique balcony crop with rail extrusion, base plate, two fasteners, slab lip and realistic contact shadow. Include dry and wet response; rust may appear only directly below ferrous source.

assemblies.label: Late-1990s outdoor AC condenser assembly
assemblies.nominalDimensions: fallback casing 0.68 x 0.48 x 0.26 m; fan disc radius 0.17 m; two mount feet and plates
assemblies.manufacture: molded ABS/HIPS casing over metal chassis; steel fan grille; insulated copper refrigerant pair under wrap; flexible condensate drain
assemblies.mounting: plastic feet/chassis seated on galvanized plates and fasteners; pipe pair routes to sealed wall collar; pipe clips retain vertical run
assemblies.interfaces: fan grille/casing gap, foot-to-plate contact, refrigerant bend, wall collar/penetration seal, drain outlet and pipe clips
assemblies.orientationExposure: partly balcony-sheltered; outer face gets sun/rain; top accumulates sheltered dust; drain/penetration zones stay locally damp
assemblies.aging: plastic UV yellowing/chalking, dust on top ledge, grime behind grille, localized damp/runoff near drain and wall penetration
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: casing panels, fan, grille, feet, plates, bolts, line pair, drain, collar and clips are geometry; plastic grain/oxidation and wrap grain are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Front and service-side AC close-ups. Show aged off-white plastic versus dark metal grille and warm pipe wrap. A grazing-light crop must reveal plastic edge Fresnel without making it metallic; another crop must show wall penetration and cause-based damp grime.

assemblies.label: Balcony clothes-pole receivers
assemblies.nominalDimensions: 70 x 340 x 80 mm fallback bracket; approx 45 mm receiver radius
assemblies.manufacture: formed/pressed galvanized or coated steel bracket and cylindrical pole receiver
assemblies.mounting: mechanically fixed to balcony/divider substrate; repeated manufactured dimensions with small installation-angle variation
assemblies.interfaces: bracket-to-wall contact, receiver joint and fastener points
assemblies.orientationExposure: sheltered but rain-reachable; hand/pole contact around receiver
assemblies.aging: zinc/coating dulling, recess grime, cleaner receiver contact zones; rust only at damaged ferrous points
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: bracket and receiver are geometry; contact polish/oxide/grime are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Tight balcony-side crop showing bracket thickness, receiver joint and contact wear. Avoid perfect repetition by varying installation angle only, not manufactured dimensions.

assemblies.label: Facade downpipe clamp hardware
assemblies.nominalDimensions: clamps spaced about 1.55 m vertically in fallback; 180 x 45 x 55 mm clamp envelope
assemblies.manufacture: formed galvanized steel stand-off clamp with ferrous anchor bolt
assemblies.mounting: mechanically anchored to exterior wall, maintaining stand-off between pipe and facade
assemblies.interfaces: clamp-to-wall anchor, clamp-to-pipe contact, runoff path immediately below hardware
assemblies.orientationExposure: rain exposed; runoff concentration follows pipe and clamp; wall-facing recess stays dirtier
assemblies.aging: zinc oxidation, narrow runoff staining, localized rust only at ferrous/coating breach source
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: clamp, bolt, stand-off and pipe-wall gap are geometry; oxide and runoff staining are material response

components.attachment: anchored to wall and wrapped around pipe

assemblies.lookdevBrief: Facade close-up showing pipe-wall stand-off, clamp thickness, bolt and narrow runoff path. Grazing light must separate metal edge from rough wall without fake painted highlight.
